decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly deploying threatening creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Pyroblast. The key strategy is to maintain tempo advantage through efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Daze, all while digging through the deck for more threats and answers with cards like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Expressive Iteration. With a mana base that includes a mix of fetch lands and dual lands, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control until the opponent is overwhelmed.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly close out the game. It also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to generate card advantage and dig for key cards. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by aggressively applying pressure on the opponent while protecting its own key threats. It is a streamlined and proactive strategy that aims to win the game as quickly as possible.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and resources through various spells and creatures. It utilizes powerful cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Supreme Verdict to maintain board advantage. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive creatures like Endurance and Ice-Fang Coatl to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck also has versatile cards like Prismatic Ending and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to provide additional value and flexibility in different situations. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and out-value the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to control the opponent's plays while efficiently applying pressure with a combination of cheap spells and evasive threats. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Daze, and Counterbalance to disrupt the opponent's game plan, along with powerful tempo plays like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver its opponents. The deck's mana base is designed for consistency and flexibility, allowing for smooth gameplay and the ability to adapt to various matchups.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token in order to win the game. It includes cards like Crop Rotation, Sylvan Library, and Green Sun's Zenith to help find the combo pieces quickly. In addition, the deck has disruption and protection cards like Swords to Plowshares, Endurance, and Karakas to deal with opposing threats or disruption. The mana base is designed to support the combo with fetch lands, dual lands, and utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Wasteland.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with efficient creatures. It leverages white mana producing lands in Legacy format to control the opponent's board state and keep them on the defensive. The inclusion of powerful disruptive creatures like Thalia and Spirit of the Labyrinth, along with equipment like Jitte and Batterskull, helps to maintain board presence and out value the opponent. Aether Vial allows for quick deployment of creatures, while cards like Solitude provide additional removal options. The deck aims to snowball its advantage and overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing powerful creatures and preventing them from casting spells efficiently. This is achieved through cards like Archon of Emeria, Anointed Peacekeeper, and Chancellor of the Annex. The deck also utilizes fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide, Lotus Petal, Chrome Mox, and Gemstone Caverns to accelerate its game plan. Additionally, it runs a few removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats. The deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with its aggressive creatures and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on utilizing Merfolk creatures to aggressively control the board and steadily build up a powerful army. With an array of lords boosting their power and utility creatures disrupting opponents' strategies, the Merfolk deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of Chalice of the Void and Force of Will provides additional disruption and protection. With efficient mana sources and disruptive elements like Wasteland, the deck aims to establish dominance early on and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo by using Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to mill the library, allowing Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly. The deck includes resilient creatures like Baleful Strix and Stoneforge Mystic to control the board and interact with the opponent. It also runs powerful disruption cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck.

The main strategy of this Legacy Combo - Show and Tell deck is to quickly cast Show and Tell or Cunning Wish to put Omniscience into play, allowing for free casting of cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. The deck is packed with powerful control elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells to help find combo pieces quickly. The mana base is designed to support the fast mana requirements of the deck while also providing access to Boseiju, Who Shelters All for protection against countermagic.

The deck focuses on quickly cheating powerful creatures such as Emrakul and Griselbrand into play using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with these massive threats before they have a chance to respond. The deck includes protection in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and disruption with cards like Flusterstorm. It also utilizes acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to speed up the combo and win the game as quickly as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan and apply pressure with efficient threats. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes a mix of disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze, as well as removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck aims to control the board early on while also maintaining a strong tempo advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana through spells like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond, then effectively cast a high impact spell like Ad Nauseam or Tendrils of Agony to win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes protection in the form of counterspells like Veil of Summer and disruption through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The addition of Living Wish allows the player to access additional win conditions or combo pieces from the sideboard, while the companion, Kaheera, provides additional support.

The focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption elements like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' game plans. The inclusion of Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual allows for explosive starts, while Faithless Looting helps to filter through the deck. The mana base is carefully crafted to provide the necessary colors for the spells while also allowing for efficient fetching.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and disruptive elements to control the opponent's board while quickly deploying threats to pressure them. It aims to maintain a high tempo throughout the game by efficiently countering opposing spells and removing threats with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also benefits from card selection and filtering with cards like Ponder and Brainstorm, maximizing its chances of drawing into impactful cards. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and aggressive creatures, the deck aims to quickly close out games against slower opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent through a combination of cheap and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by playing threats while keeping the opponent off balance with cards like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland. Additionally, the deck utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage.
